tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam bzhugs// rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i zhabs la phyag bgyi'o/ /rjes su bzung du gsol/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bzlas pa gnyis grub rjes/ chos 'byung bam̐ yig sogs ni mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur/ rang nyid rnal 'byor ma phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal kha dog dmar po nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba bzhin snang la rang bzhin med par bsam pa'i lus kyi dbus na yar rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan rta rnga ltar phra/ rgya skyegs ltar dmar/ chu shing ltar drang / til mar ltar gsal ba/ yas sna smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo nas spyi gtsug la byas/ mas sna lte ba'i 'khor lo la mtheb sor tsam reg pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo gro sog tsam pa/ yar sna sna bug g.yas nas spyi bo la byas/ mas sna dbu ma las mtheb sor tsam gyi ring ba/ g.yon rkyang ma la yang des 'gre/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bam̐ yig de/ rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs/ thugs khar chos 'byung bam̐ yig sogs dkyus bzhin la/ zhabs gnyis gshibs te brkyangs pa'i spyi bor dbu ma zug pa/ ro rkyang gnyis sku'i g.yas g.yon nas zhabs kyi mthil du zug pa bsam/ de nas rang sems dang rje btsun ma/ bam̐ yig dbyer med pa'i ngo bo/ lte ba'i rje btsun ma'i thugs kha'i bam̐ yig la sems cher gtad pas/ de las rje btsun ma'i sku che chung me stag lta bu'i rnam pa can chad/ sku lus g.yas phyogs nas zhabs g.yas pa'i nang na mar song / ro ma'i sne mo zhabs mthil du zug pa la zhugs/ ro ma'i nang nas yar bya nam 'phang spyod pa bzhin gyen du song / sna bug g.yas nas bung ba tshangs nas 'thon pa bzhin 'thon/ de las de 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku che chung bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs thams cad du khyab/ 'phags pa rnams la dgyes pa'i mchod pa sems can thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sogs mdor na snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i rang bzhin du byas/

'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus/ sna bug g.yon nas rkyang ma'i lam brgyud rim gyis song ba/ zhabs kyi mthil nas yar byas rje btsun ma'i bam̐ yig la thim/ de lta bu rlung 'gro 'ong dang bstun pa'am/ mi bstun yang lan ci mang sbyongs/ ma tha'ang gsum tsam/ de nas bam̐ yig la sems cher gtad pas/ de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i sku'i smad kyi phyogs la phog pas/ 'od kyi rnam pas rje btsun ma'i sku'i phyogs la yar 'dus/ de bzhin du stod la song bas mar 'dus 'od dmar po rdza ma tsam du gyur/ de yang rje btsun ma la thim/ de nas rje btsun ma de nyid snying kha'i thad du spar gyis byon pas ro rkyang gnyis kyang 'dus te/ zhabs la cung zad nar yod pa tsam/ de nas mgrin pa'i thad du spar gyis byon/ ro rkyang gnyis kyang lhag ma lus pa 'dus/ de man chad kyi dbu ma'ang sku ji ltar yar byon pa ltar 'dus/ de nas spyi bo'i thad du spar gyis byon pas dbu ma'ang 'dus te/ rje btsun ma'i sku gcig po rang sems dang dbyer med/ spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs shing / der 'gro ba'i bzhed pa drag po dang ldan pa/ spyan gzigs lugs dang / thugs kyi bzhed pa'i dmigs pa 'di/ snying kha/ mgrin pa/ lte ba gsum la'ang dgos rgyu yin/ de dang de'i skabs su de dang de la sems gtad nas cung zad re 'jog go /de nas rje btsun ma mkha' spyod du gshegs pa ste/ je mtho nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyi spros med la ci gnas mnyam par gzhag de la mi gnas na/ mkha' spyod nas rje btsun ma slar rang nyid 'dug pa'i thad tsam du byon/ de'i rkyen gyis ro rkyang dbu ma rje btsun ma yang gsal btab/ sngar bzhin gyi dmigs pa rnams bya/ de 'dra ba lan ci mang bya'o/ /'di la mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba zhes bzhed do/

/ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun zin bris rnams las legs par btus te brjed thor bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// /mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag nyams su len tshul mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir mkha' spyod bsgrub/ /rang nyid rdo rje btsun mo'i skur gsal ba'i/ /lus dbus drang por a wa dhu ti'i rtsa/ /rta rnga phra til mar me ltar gsal/ /rgya skyegs ltar dmar chu shing ltar drang ba'i/ /g.yas su ro ma g.yon du rkyang ma gnyis/ /kha dog dkar dmar sbom phra gro sog tsam/ /rtsa gsum mas sna rang gi lte ba dang / /yas sna dbu ma spyi bo'i gtsug zug cing / /ro rkyang rnam gnyis sna bug la zug pa/ /lte ba'i rtsa gsum 'dzoms sar bam̐ yig dang / /rang sems dbyer med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mtheb sor tshad tsam sku mdog phyag mtshan dang / /rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ /de la rang sems gtad pas de nyid las/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo me stag tsam zhig cha/ /bya rgyal nam 'phang spyod ltar ro ma yi/ /nang nas brgyud de sna bug g.yas su byon/ /de las mkha' spyod che chung grangs med pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab nyi zer rdul ltar 'phros/ /snod bcud kun khyab sangs rgyas byang sems rnams/ /mchod pas mnyes par byas te thugs rgyud bskul/ /snod bcud ma dag dag pa rab 'byams bsgyur/ /kun kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas/ /skad cig nyid la tshur 'dus sna g.yon pa'i/ /bu khar 'dus tshe sngar gyi rnal 'byor ma/ /chung ngu de la thim zhing de nyid kyang / /sna g.yon bu kha nas zhugs rkyang ma brgyud/ /rang gi lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim/ /slar yang sngar bzhin spro dang bsdu ba yis/ /don gnyis sgrub cing yang ni spro bsdu yis/

/kun khyab kun 'dus kun kyang lte bar thim/ /de nas lte ba'i mkha' spyod dbang mo las/ /'od dmar 'phros shing lus kyi nang khyab pas/ /yan lag 'od zhu lus thim de nyid kyang / /'od phung dmar por zhu zhing de tsam na/ /lte ba'i rang sems dga' ma mkha' spyod la/ /'byon par chas te spyan gsum steng phyogs kyi/ /dag pa mkha' spyod la gzigs de phyogs su/ /'byon par bzhed pas nar tsam rgyang tsam byon/ /dus der dbu ma dbu yi gtsug nas thim/ /ro rkyang sne gnyis gyen gug rnal 'byor ma'i/ /zhabs mthil 'byar ba gyen 'then je thung gyur/ /de nas snying mgrin thad du dga' ma byon/ /de dang dus mnyam lus kyi 'od phung yang / /smad nas rim bzhin yal nas der thim gyur/ /de nas rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /spyi gtsug byon te rtsa gsum 'od phung bcas/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo de la sib kyi thim/ /de yi rkyen gyis rnal 'byor ma de nyid/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su me stag yar ba'am/ /rtsal chen skyes bus nam mkhar mda' 'phangs ltar/ /blos mi 'khyud pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings na yar/ /yer gyis byon nas rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod du phebs pa dang nam mkhar 'ja' tshon nam/ /du ba yal ltar chos sku stong nyid kyi/ /ngang du thim nas zung 'jug 'bar bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar lus sems khong slod nas mnyam par 'jog /de ltar sems spros med du gnas pa de las rtog pa 'phro na/ yang ni mkha' spyod dbyings su rang gi sems/ /mkha' spyod dga' ma mtheb sor tshad tsam zhig /thol gyi byung nas thur du bya 'bab ltar/ /rang nyid 'dug pa'i gnas byon de'i rkyen gyis/ /rang nyid phyi yi rnal 'byor ma nyid dang / /ro rkyang dbu ma lte bar gnas pa yi/ /rdo rje btsun mo sngar bzhin rab gsal ba/ /gsal la rtog med bde la zhen med gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la de lta bu'i dmigs pa de nyid tshar nyer gcig gam/

bdun nam/ gsum la sogs pa skabs dang sbyar nas bya'o/ /de nas rje btsun mkha' spyod dga' mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i mkhas grub tshar pa chos rje blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam 'di yang btab ste/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni/ /srid zhi'i mig 'phrul cir yang 'char ba las/ /deng 'dir mkha' spyod dpa' mo yid 'ong ma/ /snying nas dran no 'khyud pa'i rtse dgas skyong / /'og min zhing na lhan skyes rgyal yum ma/ /nyer bzhi'i yul na zhing skyes ḍā ki ma/ /nor 'dzin khyab pa'i karma mu tra ma/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi skyabs mchog rje btsun ma/ /khyod ni sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal te/ /rdo rje'i grong na e dbyings bam̐ gyi dngos/ /sgyu ma'i gling na 'jigs rung srin mo dang / /'dzum dkar g.yo ba'i lang tsho gsar par ston/ /bdag gis ji ltar btsal yang 'phags ma khyod/ /bden par grub pa'i nges pa ma brnyes nas/ /spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi gzhon nu de/ /brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal gso bsten/ /e ma da ni ḍā ki dbyings nas bzhengs/ /he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog /bklags pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs/ /o ḍī bi sha'i bas mtha'i nags khrod du/ /grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje dril bu pa/ /'khyud dang tsum+bha'i bde bas rjes bskyangs te/ /kha sbyor mchog gi rol bzhin bdag kyang skyongs/ gaṅga'i gling du rje btsun ku sa li/ /mngon sum nam mkha'i dbyings su khrid pa dang / /dpal ldan nā ro ta pa rjes bzung ltar/ /bdag kyang mkha' spyod dge ba'i grong du khrid/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gi thugs rje dang / /rgyud chen gsang mtha'i myur lam zab khyad dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dad pa'i mthus/ /mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum dkar myur mthong shog

/ces smon lam btab cing / gzugs mthong tshad bla ma dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa'i sku/ sgra thos tshad bla ma dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa'i gsung / sems kyi 'gyu rtog thams cad bla ma dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa'i thugs kyi rang bzhin du shes par byas nas nyin mtshan 'khor yug 'gro chag nyal 'dug sogs dus thams cad du oṃ gsum ma'i sngags zlo ba la chig bsgril du byas nas/ nyin re bzhin gong du bstan pa'i man ngag la nyams len chag med du byas na/ las chung ngus don chen po tshe rabs gtan legs kyi mdun ma zin pa ni man ngag zab mo'i gnad kyi don yin pas/ rgyu mtshan ngag las btsal lo/ /gong gi man ngag gi steng du gnad 'di yang shes dgong pa yin te/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung las/ nam zhig sgyu ma'i skyes chen 'degs pa'i tshe/ /rang sems skye med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du yud kyis spor/ /drin chen bla ma'i thugs khar rgyangs kyis 'phos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang yid la 'jags pa gal che ba lags/ de ltar mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam 'di/ /rang dang 'bral med 'grogs pa'i slob bu'i mchog /rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams ming can la/ /rgyun gyi nyams len snying por sbyin pa yin/ /'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring bsam don kun grub cing / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /mkha' spyod dbang mos bde ba can khrid shog /ces mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag nyams su len tshul mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rje btsun mus pa chen po'i gsung las skyes pa'i theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can bzhugs pa'i tshom dmar gyi nyi 'od 'khyil par/

rang gzhan thams cad mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang thob pa'i gdeng brnyes pa lta bu'i man ngag zab mo 'di la dwang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa chen po'i ngang nas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i shab stod pa bkra shis don grub bo/ /bkra shis bde legs kyi dpal dang ldan par gyur cig/ //rtsa ro ma la rten pa'i yi ge bzhi/ rkyang ma la rten pa'i yi ge lnga/ dbu ma la rten pa'i yi ge bzhi/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdo'i yi ge 'bru gcig ste bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'o/ lte ba'i lkog sor bzhi nas dbu ma'i rgyun zad do/ /rtsa ro rkyang dbu ma/ bha ga'i ye ge bcu bzhi rnams kyi dbyibs tshul bkod pa 'di ni/ sems la gzung 'dzin gyi dbang gis rigs drug gi bag chags bzhag pa/ lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du yod pa rnam dbye shes pa'i phyir du dpe ris rnying ma dag las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin la/ rgyas bshad ngag las btsal bar bya zhing / rtsa gsum gyi mas sne 'dzoms pa'i bam̐ yig 'di ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mtshon byed yin pas/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi mas sna gug pa dang / rtsa dbu ma'i nang du bam̐ yig gi mgo bo bstan pa rnams ni/ gong gi man ngag zab mo'i bsgom don gyi dpe ris yin par shes dgos so/ /dge'o// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 a myes zhabs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
